regime_context: China A-shares narrative rotation shows a narrowing leadership (6/22 eligible) concentrated in Semiconductors and AI Compute, both in persistent uptrends with healthy but not extreme breadth. The absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown in this market's history, making trend-following experimental here. Macro backdrop is AI/tech and geopolitical headlines with high unscheduled surprise, adding uncertainty.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics (#2) is within 0.013 margin of Semiconductors (#1). A confirmed handoff would require AI Compute to overtake Semiconductors in score while maintaining durability_bar >0.5 and breadth >0.3. Kill criterion: margin widens beyond 0.1 in Semiconductors' favor OR AI Compute durability falls below 0.5.

evidence: durability_bar=0.6 but theme ineligible due to low momentum score

falsifier.text: Baijiu score turns positive and rank enters top 10 within 15 trading days.
